The name Sapidah could be seen as a reminder of Allah's loving and compassionate nature and the importance of emulating these qualities in one's own behavior. Moreover, in Hadith (the Sayings and Teachings of Prophet Muhammad), it is reported that "The prophet of Allah (pbuh) said: 'The excellent character is kindness'". The name Sapidah could also serve as a reminder of the importance of being kind and compassionate towards others and speaking words that are both sweet and soothing to the soul. Ultimately, the name Sapidah embodies the essence of Allah's compassionate and loving nature and serves as a reminder for Muslims to strive towards being delightful and sweet in their own actions and interactions with others.
